intent: Teach dentist as the demonstrator; aunt working at a children’s hospital without assuming a job title; village clinic opening early; treatment helping recovery quickly; needing recovery time; ankle rest before sport; trying a regular nightly bedtime; already asleep at arrival.
picturePurpose: Original dentist/model picture provides separate person versus object targets. Five individually coded scenes and a reversible rest/play order clarify workplace activity, opening time, need versus result, nightly regularity and state at arrival. Exact labels stay in code.

我叔叔在村里的图书馆工作。油漆变干需要时间。我开门时，小狗已经睡着了。
词语提示：uncle 叔叔；paint 油漆；dry 变干。

options.text: My uncle works in the village library. The paint needs time to dry. The dog was already asleep when I opened the door.
My uncle borrows books from the village library. The paint needs time to dry. The dog was already asleep when I opened the door.

answer.display: My uncle works in the village library. The paint needs time to dry. The dog was already asleep when I opened the door.

explanation.strategy: 核对活动、完成进度与到达某一刻的状态。

steps.text: 叔叔在那里工作：works in the village library。
steps.reason: borrows books借书不是原句的工作。

steps.text: 油漆变干需要时间：needs time to dry。
steps.reason: already completely dry补出了已经完全变干的结果。

steps.text: 开门时已经睡着：was already asleep when I opened the door。
steps.reason: fell asleep after把已经睡着改成了开门后才入睡。

distractors.reason: borrows books把工作改成了借书。
already completely dry把需要时间改成了已经完全变干。
fell asleep after把开门时已经睡着改成开门后才睡着。

explanation.pitfall: 在哪里工作不等于去那里办事；需要时间不等于已经完成；已经睡着是指定时刻的状态。
